source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    # The horizontal non-background pattern is the stamp; isolated marker cells
    # receive that pattern centered on their position.
    pattern = None
    for row in grid:
        cells = [i for i, v in enumerate(row) if v != bg]
        if len(cells) > 1:
            pattern = [row[i] for i in range(min(cells), max(cells) + 1)]
            break
    if pattern is None:
        return out
    markers = [(r, c, v) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != bg and all(
        (rr != r or cc != c) for rr, rrw in enumerate(grid) for cc, x in enumerate(rrw) if x != bg
    )]
    # Markers are isolated non-background cells, unlike the multi-cell stamp.
    for r, c, v in markers:
        if c == 0 and len(pattern) == 0: continue
        start = c - len(pattern) // 2
        for j, color in enumerate(pattern):
            if 0 <= start + j < len(out[r]):
                out[r][start + j] = color
    return out
'''
